name: Puzzles for smart: Dogs

short_description: THIS IS TORTURE TOGETHER is an online co-op horror game for 1-4 players, following a structured campaign with randomized elements. Abducted by a sinister kidnapper, you now must escape his deranged facility, survive twisted abominations, solve puzzles, and reach one of several endings.
name: THIS IS TORTURE TOGETHER

short_description: You are alone on an island, trying desperately to survive amongst the village tribes of savages. To do this you need food, water, and shelter. Hunt animals, plant crops, tame and breed animals, make weapons, armors and potions, raid villages, defend your base, fight with big creatures...
name: Trials of Wilderness

short_description: Is a puzzle game in which you want to build an image (with dogs) so that the picture was like the original image. Move the puzzle tiles wisely to collect the correct order of the image pieces. The essence of the game as in the old game "Tag" (15).
name: Intelligence: Dogs

short_description: Run fast and free as a sheepdog in a beautiful but troubled world. Herd masses of lost sheep to a secret refuge. Discover a mysterious calamity that only you can stop.
name: The Free Shepherd

short_description: True survival techniques: you live on what you discover. Everything here is connected - fire and rain, meat and predators, calories and every move you make. Day and night decide what is possible - being in the right place at the right hour is a skill. Your choices, your survival.
name: AREAZ

short_description: Double Pug Switch is a tough sidescrolling platformer, you take control of a pug who can switch dimensions due to a catastrophe in a lab. Run, jump, power-up and cry your way through several levels of doggy dimension goodness.
name: Double Pug Switch

short_description: Mini Matches is a 1 to 4 player party game. Race, shoot, golf, jump, and compete with your friends across a series of frenetic rounds. Level up to unlock new characters and power up your abilities.
name: Mini Matches

short_description: An online and local party game of teamwork and betrayal for 4-15 players...in space!
name: Among Us

short_description: Doggone tired of the typical brawler or tower defense that is all bark and no bite? Then join Alpha and T. Juan on a dynamic adventure that has you battling hordes of baddies and bosses on their mission to save all the Doggos!
name: The Last Friend

short_description: Hope Land is a land of dreams that every survivor wants to visit at least once. It is up to you to survive and reach your goal and how.
name: HopeLand

short_description: Top down, action packed, multiplayer, zombie shooter. Build your base with friends and see how long you can survive the endless horde of zombies. Level up with friends, or alone, how you die is up to you.
name: Zombie Builder Defense

short_description: Morphies Law is a wacky mass stealing, robot morphing 3D shooter where size really matters!
name: Morphies Law: Remorphed

short_description: To The Rescue! is a charming dog shelter simulator. Take care of unique dogs and find the right homes for as many of them as you can. Upgrade your shelter, control disease outbreaks, learn each dog's preferences, and make tough decisions, all while helping support real-world animal shelters!
name: To The Rescue!

short_description: First Class Trouble is a party game where players must work together and against each other to survive a disaster. The goal is to shut down a deadly A.I. Some players are impostors, secretly playing as human-looking killer robots intent on betraying the other players.
name: First Class Trouble

short_description: The Bloons are back and better than ever! Get ready for a massive 3D tower defense game designed to give you hours and hours of the best strategy gaming available.
name: Bloons TD 6

short_description: The world is a vast, beautiful and dangerous place – especially when you have been shrunk to the size of an ant. Can you thrive alongside the hordes of giant insects, fighting to survive the perils of the backyard?
name: Grounded

short_description: Experience unparalleled board control and responsiveness while you skate iconic real-world skate spots. This is the evolution of skateboarding gameplay. With Independent Foot Control and unique physics-based gameplay, skate gamers finally have the expressive controls they have always dreamed of.
name: Skater XL - The Ultimate Skateboarding Game

short_description: This is a visual novel about a lovestory with 6 routes, numerous CGs and 200,000 words. Small town, afternoon, leisure is in the air. A young man is trying to straighten himself up and finally say it to the girl of his dream. The girl shocked him with an unexpected answer. "I'm sorry, which of us do you like?"
name: My 1/6 Lover

short_description: "Paws in the Maze," a thrilling adventure where you take on the role of a big-hearted pitbull on a mission to rescue two lost puppies trapped in a vast, dark labyrinth. As the brave protagonist, you must rely on your keen senses and powerful bark to locate the wayward pups and guide them to safety.
name: Paws in the Maze

short_description: Hell is Others is an extraction top-down shooter combining roguelike elements. Outside the safety of your apartment lies the noir hellscape that is Century City. A city of endless night that straddles the line between reality and insanity. Explore, hunt, and loot in a place where blood is currency.
name: Hell is Others

short_description: Realistic 3D Canasta simulation with singleplayer, multiplayer and tutorial. With configurable AI strength and many adjustable rule and game variants you can start exciting Canasta tournaments - or just play for fun!
name: Canasta 3D Premium

short_description: An online co-op horror game where you pacify, weaken and capture supernatural creatures for PAH Inc. Each level has a different story, unique monsters, and multiple endings. Play single player or together with up to 6 friends. Includes proximity voice chat with fun effects.
name: Pacify

short_description: Are you ready, kids? The cult classic is back, faithfully remade in spongetastic splendor! Play as SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy and show the evil Plankton that crime pays even less than Mr. Krabs.
name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom - Rehydrated

short_description: Sierra Madre: The Wild West is a western, open world first person shooter survival game set in the 1870s. You play as a U.S. Marshall in the Wild West. Hunt outlaws, save the locals, and do whatever it takes to survive in your quest to rid the Wild West of injustice.
name: Sierra Madre: The Wild West

short_description: Campido is a unique card game which challenge your wits, strategy, memory and management skills. The game is set in a fantasy universe, in which humanoid mammals are replacing the regular and normal human characters you are always used to see.
name: Campido

short_description: The DOGE is back!
name: Montaro RE

short_description: Join Melon in this Misadventure that takes him through 6 amazing chapters, Snow, Caves, Forest, Swamp, Mountains and Corrupted lands to battle through corrupted creatures and to make your way back to the village and save the world from this evil.
name: The Misadventure Of Melon

short_description: 1001 Jigsaw. World Tour: Home Sweet Home: brain teasers around the family hearth.
name: 1001 Jigsaw. Home Sweet Home

short_description: Explore a beautiful open world where you deliver mail, find artifacts, help people out, and fend off folks you’ve wronged.
name: Thousand Threads

short_description: The Master Chief’s iconic journey includes six games, built for PC and collected in a single integrated experience. Whether you’re a long-time fan or meeting Spartan 117 for the first time, The Master Chief Collection is the definitive Halo gaming experience.
name: Halo: The Master Chief Collection

short_description: A crazy multiplayer party game in which lumberjacks try to complete tasks with nature fighting them every step of the way. Race against the clock, fight wildfires, pirates, and extremely annoying monkeys as you travel around the world and through time. Play online/local co-op and pvp or play solo.
name: Lumberhill

short_description: Bound By Blades is an Indie Action-RPG with a focus on intense boss battles. Experience the thrill of Boss Rushes with the wholesomeness of a cozy Indie RPG as you confront ferocious foes, collect loot, and craft epic gear to fortify yourself for the challenges ahead, solo or in 2 player co-op!
name: Bound By Blades

short_description: London, 1888: The people of Whitechapel live under the ghastly shadow of Jack the Ripper, tempting Arthurian legends - Du Lac & Fey - back to English shores to intervene. Will they stop Jack before more blood is spilt on the cobbled streets? Victorian London awaits you...
name: Dance of Death: Du Lac & Fey

short_description: Get your heart racing and blood pumping for the thrill of approaching prey and pulling the trigger with perfect timing and aim. Perfect your hunting skills behind the rifle by practicing on nature's bounty in this virtual reality experience.
name: Hunting Simulator VR

short_description: Just Die Already is an old people mayhem sandbox game created by the designers of Goat Simulator. You are old and angry and you've just been kicked out of your retirement home. How will you survive in a world that wants you to Just Die Already?
name: Just Die Already

short_description: Hunters to your rifles! Bring out your shooter skills in Hunter and his 3 different game modes!
name: Hunter

short_description: Beat Me! is a physics-based multiplayer game for up to 6 players. Play with comical fantasy characters in a wide variety of fun and surprising environments. Challenge your friends locally or beat others over the internet!
name: Beat Me!

short_description: CLOSE YOUR EYES. BECOME A WARRIOR: Feel your enemy’s rasping breath; a foot shifts on swampy ground; the crack of steel on wooden shield. The Vale is an audio based action adventure that sets out to breathe new life into medieval combat and fantasy narrative.
name: The Vale: Shadow of the Crown

short_description: Hello! Captain! “Sea Of Craft” is a sandbox ocean-building game with realistic physics simulation. In “Sea of Craft”, you can build your exclusive ship with hundreds of materials, and explore intriguing stages on planet Beella as well as adventures of wonders in the great ocean!
name: Sea of Craft

short_description: The gleaning club is an immersive game experience hall, where you can participate in the script arranged according to the story by role playing. Or learn folk knowledge and taste strange culture, or realize the sad but warm past of the protagonist of the story.
name: Notes of Soul

short_description: Skinwalker Hunt is a horror themed hunting game from the creator of Witch Hunt. Main focus of the game is on exploration, non-linear gameplay, and atmosphere.
name: Skinwalker Hunt

short_description: “Build and Fight” multiplayer for mature players. Build your own Machine, join combat and win the battle using tactics and strategy.
name: War Builder League

short_description: Take control of a Soviet locomotive and embark on a dangerous journey along the world's longest railway line. Face mafia rivals, bandits, wild animals, constant breakdowns, severe frosts, hunger, and... a hangover. How far will you get before your supplies run out?
name: Trans-Siberian Railway Simulator

short_description: The Undisputables : Online Multiplayer is a PvP online multiplayer TPS shooter game with fantastic comic cartoon 3D graphics and captivating gameplay.
name: The Undisputables : Online Multiplayer Shooter

short_description: Online (6v2) social deduction game that will ruin your friendships. 6 crew members, 2 murderous shape-shifting aliens. Trust No One.
name: Enemy On Board

short_description: Help Fireboy and Watergirl explore the 7 Elemental temples!
name: Fireboy & Watergirl: Elements

short_description: Frantic Gameplay, Juicy Visuals, Hypnotic Beats: SPITLINGS is a cute but unforgiving Hardcore Arcade Game for 1 - 4 players in which you waggle through a gauntlet of bouncy bubbles.
name: SPITLINGS

short_description: MyIsland is a relaxed and beautiful survival game,You will drift and survive on the tropical islands, hunt and travel, build houses and development farming, and create your own warm homeland.
name: My Island

short_description: Let's do sit-ups! Let a chubby boy do his exercise and sink into a dog's body. Maybe animals will come to cheer him up.
name: My Exercise

short_description: It is a very funny, fast and easy game which can be played by adults as well as children. This game has two teams that try to prevent each other from winning.
name: Hide and Seek

short_description: Stand and fight for humanity. This arcade shooter takes place in the year 2022, as the Earth Defense Force fends off an all-out attack by unknown life forms. Become an EDF soldier, battle against endless hordes of immense enemies, and restore peace to the earth.
name: EARTH DEFENSE FORCE 5

short_description: Experience a unique game that combines the challenge of Golf with the rules of 8-ball Pool (Blackball)! Set in various beautiful and physically realistic environments, Golf Pool VR is a competitive and fun game you can play by yourself vs AI or MP with friends.
name: Golf Pool VR

short_description: Ditch pre-calculated animations for pure, physics-based soccer chaos! Master wacky sphere controls, execute timely dashes, and trigger explosive arcade power-ups. Soccering delivers fast, unpredictable football fun perfect for solo play or hilarious local and remote matches with friends.
name: Soccering

short_description: Extreme 2D physics action with detailed destruction of vehicles, robots, creatures, and your own Pioneer - now over ONLINE multiplayer! Quickly jump into a dozen different game modes hosted on free servers worldwide to battle, cooperate, race, and survive with/against other Pioneers all over the globe!
name: Planetoid Pioneers Online

short_description: Kunio, the beloved hot-blooded renegade, is back to wreak havoc in the world of the Three Kingdoms! The characters take on the roles of famous generals for a game packed with wild action.
name: River City Saga: Three Kingdoms

short_description: PERISH is a stylish 1-4 player FPS with a cross to bear. Slay hordes of creatures on the black sands of Purgatory and sell their gold-stained corpses to craven priests. Kill magnificent bosses and use the proceeds to gain entrance to Elysium, a place of cosmic revelations.
name: PERISH

short_description: Survive in a medieval world filled with tower-defense, magic, exploration, and building. Use a unique directional combat system. Explore a rich world with dynamic weather that impacts gameplay. Uncover the secrets of the land and emerge victorious in this ultimate survival game.
name: Age Of Omens

short_description: Shoot and deflect bullets as a frog equipped with a gun, a buckler and a sticky tongue.
name: GUN AND BUCKLER

short_description: Unrailed! is a co-op multiplayer game where you have to work together with your friends to build a train track across endless procedurally generated worlds. Master random encounters with its inhabitants, upgrade your train and keep it from derailing!
name: Unrailed!

short_description: Human Error is a single player social deduction game. The factory is watching and every mistake is tracked. Perform industrial tasks alongside machines and mimic their efficiency. Survive tense interrogations where the machines analyze your performance to root out the human infiltrator.
name: Human Error

short_description: X-POINT is an uncompromising RTS and a 3rd-person simulator. Total control: from satellite maps to managing infantry, tanks, and carriers. Looking for an easy game? This isn’t for you. Will you quit after the first losses, or prove you can win? See you on the satellite map.
name: X-POINT

short_description: Have you got what it takes to be a Wanba Warrior? Step into the absurd world of calligraphy combat and prepare to lay the smackdown upon all who dare to oppose you, dishing out damage with your chosen ink brush of brutality! highly recommend playing with controllers.
name: Wanba Warriors

short_description: Bullet Hell Insanity + Tower Defense Strategy. Rogue Star Rescue is a quirky new type of rogue-like shooter. Blast your way through diverse planets while rescuing your teammates and gathering traps for your defense strategy. Play solo or online to stop the Rogue Star before it annihilates everything!
name: Rogue Star Rescue

short_description: Choppy Waves is an online co-op party game for up to 4 players where you run a floating bar on the open ocean, mixing drinks and serving customers while waves send everyone sliding across the deck.
name: Choppy Waves

short_description: Jump into shooter where armed fleas fight over objectives with guns, bites, and rideable insects. Capture points, support your allies, and cause complete chaos using a mix of firearms, hilarious bite attacks, and strange insect companions that can carry you into battle.
name: Flea Madness

short_description: A 2D shooter with unusual movement mechanics, because our character has a simple circle with a face. You have to explore complex abstract worlds and fight with other players and abstract personalities using quite familiar weapons.
name: YOBA2D

short_description: The cat girls are back in NEKO-NIN exHeart 2 Love +PLUS! Enjoy four short stories for each main heroine taking place after the events of NEKO-NIN exHeart 2.
name: NEKO-NIN exHeart 2 Love+PLUS

short_description: Fear clouds the mind. Fear paralyzes the body. If your hands are shaking with fear, you will remain in this hell forever.
name: Hand Simulator: Horror

short_description: Become iconic animals and fight for survival in the The WILDS. Finding food, water, and shelter will be the easy part, protecting your family from hungry predators and a harsh environment will separate the weak from the strong. Welcome to a uniquely immersive animal experience...
name: The WILDS

short_description: Put your love for pups to the test - we have a bunch of dogs that need their photos taken, doggone it! Photograph and catalogue the finest (and derpiest) dogs to build your career, upgrade your camera, and discover new canines. WOOF.
name: Pupperazzi: The Dog Photography Game

short_description: Neko Neko Rampage is a co-op built for quick bursts of chaos! Jump into a round, knock things over, have fun, and leave behind a trail of disaster. It’s not about long adventures or endless grinding, it’s about the joy of instant mischief and laughs.
name: Neko Neko Rampage

short_description: Shoot The Zombirds VR is a gallery shooter starring undead birds, pumpkins and a crossbow. Excellent shooting fun for all skill levels.
name: Shoot The Zombirds VR

short_description: Sheep Collision is a party game developed by two-man team: father and son. Play as sheep and fight for your meadow: solo or online up to 4 players. There is no space for other flocks!
name: Sheep Collision

short_description: Make your dreams come true with Animal Doctor! Would you like to spend your life caring for animals? With Animal Doctor you will be surrounded by animal friends and pets.
name: Animal Doctor

developers: Ringling College of Art and Design
publishers: Ringling College of Art and Design
short_description: Race against the clock and clean up these mucky pups! Created by Virtual Reality Development students at Ringling College of Art and Design.
name: Wet Dog Corp

short_description: Pat the dogs... and then their owners. Step into the world of Rainbow Bay in Best Friend Forever, a dating sim-meets-dog care sim where you pat, pamper and train your pup while you search for your own forever friend.
name: Best Friend Forever

short_description: Disobedient Sheep is a frantic and lighthearted sheep herding party game for two to four players. Play as adorable sheepdogs and guide your hapless flock to victory in four different game-modes by avoiding anvils, dodging dynamite, and bailing on boulders.
name: Disobedient Sheep

short_description: Set in a world after the destruction of humankind, the harsh battle of the combat dog "Pochi" begins. Explore dungeons that change every time you enter, get a wide variety of weapons, and power up your dog! Hunt the evil "WANTED"! Enjoy exhilarating battles casually in this shooting action game.
name: METAL DOGS

short_description: An extreme response to minor problems. MAXIMUM THUNDERNESS is a roguelike side-scrolling co-op action game where you battle space alien criminals attempting to conquer Earth through a series of increasingly petty crimes.
name: Maximum Thunderness

short_description: Zedfest is the goriest game show ever created! A hardcore 6 player co-op third-person shooter with the goal to complete objectives while neutralizing Zeds with lots and lots of visceral gore.
name: Zedfest

short_description: PC & VR Cross-platform action adventure game set in a comically dark world of weird and badass creatures. Gear up and invite your friends as these battles over the dominions of different Architects are ever-lasting. And choose carefully which clan you wish to serve.
name: Cradle of Sins

short_description: Get ready to Bark’em Up! Play as Bullet, a C³ class (Cute Cybernetic Corgi) pup on his quest to save his owner, a brilliant scientist kidnapped by an alien race that wants to rule the galaxy. ProtoCorgi is a retro pixel art shoot’em up with a strong arcade feel!
name: ProtoCorgi

short_description: Unusual 3d parking puzzle with kicking mechanics. Kicking is fun! Kick a car from the parking lot alone or with friends. And don't think that it will be easy.
name: Bunny Parking

short_description: Experience general aviation as never before! World of Aircraft is a series of stand-alone simulators that each focus on a specific kind of flying. World of Aircraft: Glider Simulator includes a series of (motor-) gliders and tow aircraft based on a high definition flying area.
name: World of Aircraft: Glider Simulator

short_description: Fight against other survivors for limited resources, beware of mutants, survive. You are the creators of your story at Enersify and everyone has their own path.
name: Enersify

short_description: This is a very fun, fast and simple game, both adults and children can play it. Each of the players has his own cowboy for whom you need to collect ammunition in order for him to shoot at your opponent.
name: Night shot

short_description: Help Rupert and Riley survive by catching delicious fish in this addictive underwater shooting adventure! Enjoy 20 levels and unique bosses on each island.
name: Rupert and Riley Shipwrecked

short_description: Gather your courage and face the ghost danger.Clean the curses and hunt the ghost!
name: Desdemona

short_description: Peekaboo — Hide & Seek Online. Players are divided into two teams: props and hunters.Props take the form of objects and adopt their physical properties, and hunters are trying with all their might to find them.
name: Peekaboo

short_description: You are one of the chosen survivors to set up your life in UNKNOWN REGION. Life has forever changed after an unknown virus has wiped out humanity. Navigate through the region to discover mutated humans and creatures. You will be challenged to test your survival skills.
name: UNKNOWN REGION

short_description: Knight Squad 2 is a chaotic arcade multiplayer game for up to 8 players. Pick an eccentric knight and fight for glory with wacky weaponry. Triumph over your friends in a ridiculous amount of game modes, both offline and online.
name: Knight Squad 2

short_description: Develop a steady hand, line up your sights, and master the skills to take the perfect shot.
name: The Hunt in the Forest

short_description: Control a team of 4 characters, switching between them to use their unique abilities. ZIC: Zombies In City is a first person zombie survival shooter.
name: ZIC – Zombies in City

short_description: This exciting collection brings you 12 games in one, from developer Technos Japan known for creating the legendary River City and Double Dragon series. From arcade classics to region-exclusive titles, you’ll have plenty to explore in this collection! Get your hands on these rare games of legend!
name: Super Technos World: River City & Technos Arcade Classics

short_description: In Granny Simulator there are two players, a feeble old grandmother and her lovely grandson. The grandmothers objective is to complete her every day routine while the grandson utilizes uncanny violence and pure brutality to stop her.
name: Granny Simulator

short_description: Solve mysteries, find the lost, help people in trouble, track down criminals and save lives in this blind-accessible canine adventure! Meet Biscuit, the one-and-only doggo detective! User her superpowered hearing and scent tracking skills to make the world a better place than how you found it!
name: Lost and Hound

short_description: The Red Lantern is a narrative, dog sledding game about survival. You play as the Musher who, along with her team of 5 sled dogs, must find her way home. Care for your dogs, discover their stories, and learn how to navigate the unknowns of the Alaskan wilderness and prepare for your new life.
name: The Red Lantern

short_description: Fling to the Finish is a cooperative racing game where teammates are tethered together by a stretchy elastic rope. Get up close and personal with your partner to maneuver two characters bouncing, rolling, and flinging their way to the finish line!
name: Fling to the Finish

short_description: It's ten years since the infection started. Long-established settlements are collapsing, one by one, for unknown reasons. Survivors are running to the hills to escape, hoping for safety in remote places. As another refugee, you're here to carve out a new life for yourself - by any means necessary.
name: Survivalist: Invisible Strain

short_description: Be quick to think, as you progress in the game you use more and more logic in a fun puzzle.
name: CoronaViruses

short_description: This is a beautiful and fun network shooter. Complete missions alone or with friends. In “Quiet Sleep” you perform the role of a military man who arrived at point “M” to guard the medical center.
name: Quiet Sleep

short_description: Murder. Nothin’ nice about it. In this old school detective adventure, step into the boots of whip-smart Inspector Waffles and travel the city to track hidden clues, interrogate shady suspects, and unravel a dangerous mystery. But be warned: curiosity killed the cat...
name: Inspector Waffles

short_description: Conan Chop Chop is a party roguelite for 1-4 players full of mayhem, loot, and adventure. In this outrageous take on Conan the Barbarian, you are the muscle-bound hero foolish enough to try and stop the evil wizard Thoth-Amon!
name: Conan Chop Chop

short_description: Get your crew back together for the ultimate heist experience! Return to Monaco, plan your operation, and skedaddle when things inevitably go awry in this co-op heist game. The city is yours for the taking!
name: Monaco 2

short_description: Fight fires for fun and profit in this unpredictable and frantic multiplayer game. Team up with friends, take on daily challenges and climb to the top of the corporate firefighting ladder. More than one way to become a hero!
name: Embr

short_description: OddBallers™ is a totally bonkers multiplayer party game where each round is a new, absurd type of dodgeball.
name: OddBallers

short_description: The player slips into the role of the android, one of the 8 crew members in "Space Escape VR". There are 8 different jobs to choose from. The aim is to complete the rescue ship before the research ship explodes. "SpaceEscapeVR" can be played cooperatively with up to 8 players
name: SpaceEscapeVR

short_description: Startup chaos for 1–4 players, solo or online co-op. Everyone is a co-founder and everyone thinks they're the CEO. Ship it half-baked, bluff investors, fight over the last dollars. Become a unicorn — or a meme.
name: Definitely A Unicorn

short_description: Micro Mages is a platformer developed for the original 8-bit NES console. Now on Steam! ROM included. Play solo or with up to 4 players simultaneously. Compete over score or cooperate to overcome challenging levels.
name: Micro Mages

short_description: Dungeon Scavenger is a unique turn-based old school dungeon crawler that sets you on a challenging path of exploration. Select a hero to keep the threat of the dungeon and demon realms away from the town's people with an innovative combat system. Can you save the town from the danger below?
name: Dungeon Scavenger

short_description: Take up your sword and shield and go on a quest with your friends in QUEST TOGETHER Online, the VR MMORPG. Rise up the ranks in the adventurers guild, hang out with your fellow questers, make new friends, team up together for adventure, or partake in some PVP matches!
name: QUEST TOGETHER Online

short_description: Biped is a coop action adventure game with a strong focus on moment-to-moment collaboration between 2 players.
name: Biped

short_description: AO Tennis 2 is the only tennis experience designed for and by its community. Create your own players, stadiums and legendary matches. Enter the competition to reach the top of world tennis in Career Mode.
name: AO Tennis 2

short_description: Adore is an action creature-collecting game where you build your team of unique creatures and go on a journey to resurrect the God of the Creatures.
name: Adore

short_description: Become a cat in a warm, quiet house. Curl up by the fire with 70+ hours of narrated classic tales, silent films and gentle trivia, or nap beside other cats. No timers, no fail states. Just a place to rest.
name: Whiskers of Yesterday

short_description: Breaking Box is a 3D multiplayer game with a level editor in-game. You can create your own levels, challenge levels, and enjoy the competition with friends!
name: Breaking Box

short_description: You’re the designer, engineer and architect if you can imagine it you can create it! Construct robots of any shape or size from eight-legged spider bots to eerie UFO contraptions.
name: Main Assembly

short_description: Face the challenge of catching ducks in a funny hand drawn forest. Outsmart hunters, cause a brawl between a wolf and a bear, use hideouts, move through underground tunnels, avoid traps but make enemies fall into them ! Be a sly fox !
name: Catch a Duck

short_description: Witchtastic is a challenging 2-4 player coop game about brewing and delivering magic potions as fast as possible. Take on the role of aspiring witches and experience charming adventures. Need a break from all the yelling of your friends? You can practice in a single player campaign as well!
name: Witchtastic

short_description: Bake ‘n Switch is a cute, yet tough couch co-op and PvP party game for 1-4 players. Embark on a 'Bun Solo' single-player adventure or team up with other Bakers to catch, throw, and bake a'dough'rable living bread creatures!
name: Bake 'n Switch

short_description: Scribble It! is a multiplayer drawing and guessing game. Get in a lobby with up to 16 players and choose from thousands of official words, packaged in a variety of high-quality themes and 3 multiplayer game modes. Perfect for game nights, parties or just hanging out with friends.
name: Scribble It!

short_description: Operation Sniff game for one or two players. In a single player game you have to play for a dog and complete all the tasks assigned to you. In the mode of confrontation, players have to choose the role of a person or a dog, and fight among themselves, destroying each other or completing all tasks.
name: Operation Sniff

short_description: ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4 is the latest evolution of PIRATE WARRIORS action! Based on the concept of "experiencing a real ONE PIECE battlefield," buildings will come crashing down during the action and attacks will throw up smoke and dust, placing you in the thick of the ONE PIECE world!
name: ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4

short_description: Raid destructible compounds using explosive gadgets and tactical weaponry in VR! Breach, clear, and dominate in high-intensity raids where destruction is your greatest weapon. Whether you're leading a squad or taking on the challenge solo, precision, strategy, and firepower will decide your victory.
name: Crunch Element

short_description: Northern Lights is an open world survival simulation set in the extreme conditions of the arctic tundra. Clinging to life, you must use real-life survival techniques to gather resources, craft, and hunt while tending to your health and sanity. Can you survive your way out of the mysterious island?
name: Northern Lights

short_description: A first-person, story-driven psychological horror game based on the cinematic lore of the Blair Witch. Explore the haunted grounds of the Black Hills Forest in a harrowing investigation that forces you to confront the evil that resides deep in the woods.
name: Blair Witch

short_description: "Escape First 2" is the second installment of a multiplayer escape room puzzle game for virtual reality or desktop PC! It includes 3 different escape rooms to choose from and can be played competitively, co-op or solo.
name: Escape First 2

short_description: Sudden disaster has put the town at risk, and you are the Incident Commander! It is up to you to control the responder teams who can stop the growing threat and save the community. The mayor is watching. Can you keep the public safe and stay within budget?

short_description: This tongue in cheek dating game pairs you up with random people as you do your best to win their hearts. Whatever your preference you can meet someone today and Flirt your pants off.

short_description: Create your own level with your friends online in the sandbox mode, play the mini-games, ragdoll, drive a car, fly with a Jetpack, fart to go higher, throw grenades. Access more than 45 items to build your own level.
name: Ragdoll Party Online

short_description: Toya Inuzuka is the successor to the family shrine but dreams of becoming a pâtissier. Complicating things further are these two fluffy-eared and bushy-tailed messengers of god, Koharu and Azuki dream to marry Toya... The three of them will have to work together to fulfill their dreams!

short_description: A gritty bounty hunter game. Play as a lonely drifter, fly across a rainy planet, and track down criminals to earn money.

short_description: Last Farewell is a Survival Co-op game where you are tasked to work together with others (or solo) in order to ensure your own survival for as long as possible. Gather supplies and craft during the day in order to protect yourself and the sanctuary, the Town Hall, during the night.
name: Last Farewell

short_description: "The Expedition" is a first person open world survival game based on a remote island in the Bermuda Triangle. Try to survive as long as you can. Gather resources to build more and more gear and discover all hidden weapons, treasures and locations.

short_description: Help keep your loved ones warm and happy in the cold outside world by spreading the heat from the main campsite to all other family members! Create a trail of warmth and help grandmas and dogs alike in this fun and wholesome puzzle game.

short_description: The Last Archwing is a fast paced, vertically scrolling space shooter. Will you and your friends take up the mantle as Earth's last defenders and thwart the plans of the evil Emperor Zarkhan?
name: The Last Archwing

short_description: Take on the hunt of a lifetime as you target and pursue monster-sized fish around the world. You’re set, waiting…. The line tightens, your alarm screams, the fish is on and the battle commences!

short_description: I came to find the truth and to find my friend. But this forbidden place is entangled in war. They prey on us night and day. I must find the strength to rise from the shadows. Soon they will all know my name. My name is UEDI.
name: UEDI: Shadow of the Citadel

short_description: Journey across space to the icy planet of Tau Volantis with Isaac Clarke and Sgt. John Carver to discover and destroy the source of the Necromorph outbreak.

short_description: In Animal Shelter, your main target is to make your four-legged friends happy. Pet them, hand out treats, play with toys - and they will pay you back with great trust. Get to know the animals well enough to find them the best home! Don't wait any longer, open your animal shelter now!

short_description: SokoBunny is new fully 3d look at classic sokoban. Play alone or with your friend online, kick the cargo in the warehouse labyrinth.

short_description: KeyWe is a cute, co-operative postal puzzler starring Jeff and Debra, two small kiwi birds working in a whimsical post office. They must jump, flap, peck and butt-slam their way across an interactive landscape of levers, bells and buttons to get those messages delivered on time!

short_description: The Hacky-Sack Platformer! Keep the ball air-born while you kick your way through sprawling levels. Use unique kicking mechanics to rescue your best friend Kevin the dog. Just DONT DROP IT!!!

short_description: A spooky teddy bear first-person shooter where you defend your owner from waves of her nightmares. Play solo or join your friends in up to 4 player online co-op.

short_description: Experience all the Onion Kingdom has to offer, Overcooked! 1 & 2 infused with 4k goodness running at a smooth 60 FPS. Fully remastered and cooked up from scratch. Enjoy 200+ levels (22 new) and 80+ chefs (3 new), this is the ultimate Overcooked! experience.

short_description: Now Online! Unspottable is a competitive party game. Blend in the crowd of AI characters, hunt down the other players and use the many different environment specific rules to win the game. Walk like a robot and punch like a human!

short_description: This is a survival game. After the coronation, human beings had to move into the underground. Fifty years later, some people thought the disaster was over and organized a survival competition on the surface. Some brave people took part in the competition . You are one of them.

short_description: A game production platform based on 3D physics engine and building block logic programming. Players who like creating games and assembling machinery can design a rich variety of custom games without having to learn and memorize complex commands and gain profit through the in-app purchase system.

short_description: Spot your prey quickly then get into position for the ultimate in hunting action! Packed with over 220 missions – including the bonus Master Campaigns – pursuing 5 species of game in 5 rich environments, Hunting Unlimited is the innovative original hit that started a long running series!

short_description: Embark on a magical journey with 3 adventurers. Overcome fearsome beasts and challenging puzzles in an online third-person co-op game with your friends.

Follow in the footsteps of Joan in the story mode or tackle procedurally generated maps that scale with your level and bring a fresh experience each game..

Find and repair the objectives, flip the master switch and escape before the ghastly ghoul that lurks in the darkness catches up to you. Play through the career mode or explore free play!

short_description: Hunting Unlimited 2 improves on the series originator with new features: free hunt mode with enhanced AI, improved graphics, more detailed scoring, user-created missions, new bulletcam mode, more types of animals to hunt and a bigger variety of sporting arms to hunt them with.

Visit your school and find all your seized items and don't get caught by the possessed principal and his pet dog and stop the principal from sacrificing his goats. Stop the Ritual, Run, Scream, hide. Just don't get caught.

short_description: In Sphere Arena you take control of a ball to roll, jump or slide through non-linear levels in order to visit all checkpoints scattered across the maps in industrial setting. Improve your skill in singleplayer or compete with other players in multiplayer mode.
name: Sphere Arena

short_description: Hidden object game in the city setting. Black and white hand-drawn graphics in a cartoon style. Ultra hard! Really very difficult!
name: 100 hidden cats 2

short_description: TV Kid is an addicting roguelike clicker game with endless possibilities for item combinations! Click through channel after channel and try to defeat television itself!
name: TV Kid

short_description: Take words to a new dimension. Arrange letters to form words, find words and decipher codes, on 2D boards or wrapped around 3D boards.
name: Word Attack

short_description: Drunken Nuke'em is a different asymmetric multiplayer horror and humor game. One player (hunter) must kill the rest. The other members (the drunkards) must find a balance between collaboration and betrayal to survive since only one or two will be able to do so.
name: Drunken Nuke'em

short_description: Pandora: Wild Origins is an animal simulation game where you play as a feline. Explore a new world and discover the mysteries of the lands of Pandora. Survive and evolve to become the most feared predator, meet a partner to start a family !
name: Pandora : Wild Origins

short_description: BlockWorld is a Multiplayer Voxel sandbox full of toys and creatures! Powered by the Hazzah Engine, you can go beyond blocks and really build amazing things. Come on in and build worlds with your friends!
name: BlockWorld

short_description: PropHunter - a fresh representative of the genre of hide and seek on the net! The players are divided into two teams - one team is hiding by taking the form and properties of objects, the second team is seek to find for impostors among props. The team that eliminates its rivals wins!
name: PropHunter

short_description: Hungaz is an online multiplayer party game with up to 70 players, where you either in a team with friends or free-for-all struggle through several rounds of challenging and unique mini-games until the last hunga or team standing. Do you have what it takes to be proclaimed the true Hungaz champion?
name: Hungaz: Epic Minigames

short_description: Survive the Hill is an asymmetrical multiplayer/co-op survival experience that supports Solo and 4/8-player options and AI versus scenarios. Blow up the exit areas with your aim to escape. Look for ways to defeat the killer, build your strategy, never wander alone.
name: Survive The Hill

short_description: This short & challenging horror adventure will drive you nuts! Type your way out of this cursed mansion and avoid the regret monster by hiding, running and setting traps. But don’t lose the rhythm of your heartbeat or make typos, they may cause you a heart attack… Fully playable without visuals.
name: Heartbeat: Regret

short_description: Hunt...Craft,,, and survive the wild west. A survival PVP extravaganza! Hunt Others, Craft your own custom bullets and bombs, Search for bosses and level up your outfit to survive the Wild west in this unique western survival game!!
name: Deliverance

short_description: Misguidead is a horror-focused co-op game. Players must work together to survive and solve puzzles while investigating mysteries from different religions.
name: Misguidead

short_description: A short story inspired by Robert Heinlein's:The Moon Is a Harsh Mistress. The first iteration in a fight for Android freedom.
name: CAT Interstellar: Recast

short_description: A Super-dimensional Adventure(?) Game. When you press something, happens something ...... Wander through a mysterious world, find your friend, and escape!! You can play calmly, without thinking so much
name: Hyper Treasure - Macaronic Labyrinth

short_description: It’s Mealtime! is a multiplayer physics game where teams of 4 players work together to manage a restaurant, even if that means having to fight against another team!
name: It's Mealtime!

short_description: A couch/online game where you battle your friends with unique and wild abilities. There are many choices such as a shrink ray, creating black holes, stopping time and attaching a rocket engine to the stage to send it flying. Choose a combination that synergizes well to win the round!
name: Bopl Battle

short_description: Join the Royal Tournament! Knighty is a funny multiplayer party game with dozens of different knightly competitions waiting for you. Avoid obstacles, compete with others, make your way to the top and fight for the Knighty title. There can be only one winner!
name: Knighty

short_description: Cosminers is a 1-4 player co-op FPP sci-fi building and mining game with survival elements based on day/night cycle. As a space miner kill various aliens on procedurally-generated planet's undergrounds. Craft and upgrade your tools, weapons & base to get countless hours of thrilling gameplay.
name: Cosminers

short_description: Hellbreach: Vegas is a Wave-based First-Person Shooter for 1-4 players, made with passion by a one man dev team! Set your loadout, kill, and earn cash. Take a spin on the various slot machines and level up to improve your survival chances. Are you ready to try your luck?
name: Hellbreach: Vegas

short_description: THE MADHOUSE | Infected Mansion is a survival horror game. Contains Fear, Stealth, Exploration/Puzzle solving, Item management. Moreover "Multiple First-Person Views" provides a new level of fear, immersion, strategy. Steal the vision of "something" lurking in the abandoned house and try to survive.
name: THE MADHOUSE | 感染屋敷

short_description: Make your own way through the wilderness: build a cozy cabin or take your tent to discover more. Retro vibes and evergreen optimism ensoul this survival adventure featuring clever craftables, curious critters, and a handful of inspiring landmarks tucked away throughout.
name: On My Own: New Frontier

short_description: Singulive is the gateway for artists and audiences to the world of virtual reality with music as the main protagonist. A place designed to enjoy the live experience and take a step forward with spectacular possibilities.
name: Singulive

short_description: TrackShot is a fast-paced tank PvP game where doing tricks earns you ammo. Grind rails, perform some flips, and land clean to load your shells, then fire them at your mates. Battle it out across a bunch of arenas and modes as you compete for air superiority.
name: TrackShot

short_description: Screwup 1.0 The update includes new features such as a new combat system, official server system, exploring new islands by ship, NPC trading, and rare item trading. There are also new hunting and pet systems, as well as many other features that will be added in future updates.
name: ScrewUp

short_description: DOG'S DONUTS is a physics-based game. Place the machines, make the adjustments and try to feed this adorable husky crazy for DONUTS.
name: DOG'S DONUTS

short_description: Deadbait is a VR Horror multiplayer (3vs1) and Story-driven Singleplayer/Coop game where one Player becomes a terrifying Murderer, and 3 Players are Survivors who need to play as a team to escape or overcome the gruesome Nightmare.
name: Deadbait

short_description: Build your dream railroad across a huge open world! You can build tracks and stations, drive detailed locomotives, and transport goods to earn money and experience. Play exciting Online Multiplayer sessions with your friends or create your very own sandbox!
name: Railroads Online

short_description: Bigger. Faster. Smarter. The ultimate cops & robbers showdown!
name: Police Sentri 2

short_description: This unique open-world game is a 1st/3rd person shooter, survival/horror role-playing game. The goal is to Survive. Overcome struggles such as hunger, thirst & exhaustion. Build shelter. Use Advanced Crafting. Clear enemy Outpost. Survive solo in Campaign Mode or with friends in Multiplayer Mode.
name: Cyber War APOCALYPSE

short_description: Simple Fish Adventure is an unusual short physics-based platformer. Jump like a fish, think like a fish, be a fish! Overcome obstacles and suffer. Also includes co-op for up to 4 players.
name: Simple Fish Adventure

short_description: "4 Rush Together" is a light-hearted and funny obstacle course game where you and your friends are tied together with a rope, adventuring through creative levels filled with fun. You can invite up to three friends to play together in local multiplayer or online co-op mode. What are you waiting for?
name: 4 Rush Together

short_description: KLETKA is a co-op (up to 6 players) horror game about going down in an elevator that is trying to eat you. Feed the elevator, explore deadly floors and descend deeper.
name: KLETKA

short_description: Cricket 22 delivers the Ashes, the Big Bash, The Hundred, and a multitude of other fan-favourite competitions! All-new mechanics, commentary, and a captivating, narrative driven career mode, will immediately immerse you in the ultimate cricket experience to date.
name: Cricket 22

short_description: Hide & Seek is a fast-paced multiplayer game of police vs thieves with cute and funny toon graphics! Make a 200 IQ move to win! 🔥🤯
name: Hide and Seek Heist: Police vs Thieves

short_description: An online multiplayer game of crafting, survival, civilization building, and player collaboration. Start in the stone age and live, build, and invent your way to higher civilization. Live and die as well as you can, to gain the experience you need to achieve even more in your next life!
name: In Next Life

short_description: Hunt the chupacabras alone or with your friends, explore the map and find the weapons to kill the monster.
name: Chupacabras: Night Hunt

short_description: You woke up in a dusty room, in an unknown place, with no memory of how you got here. Your pockets are empty, and there is something outside the door producing frightening sounds.
name: Escape From Monster

short_description: Hope For Winter is a first-person story-driven game about Lionel who arrives at his Grandparent's Cabin after many years with his trusty companion. The story takes you through Thorn Mountain Pines Forest to discover what happened to Lionel's Grandmother after all this time.
name: Hope For Winter

short_description: A co-op crafting platformer where your friends prove worse than any enemy. Craft weapons and armor from your dwarven workshop, help your patron's army win the battle, and make your way up the Iron Mountain!
name: Dorfs: Hammers for Hire

short_description: The Surelock Agency is a 4-Player Co-Op game that focuses on problem solving, item management, and teamwork to get through the missions.
name: The Surelock Agency

short_description: Obsideo is a 1-4 player online co-op psychological horror, where you and your team of priests explore different locations experiencing paranormal events in an attempt to figure out what ghost they're dealing with and exorcise it from the property.
name: Obsideo

short_description: Bankers & Bonkers is a team-based multiplayer game where two teams will fight using power-ups to get the money case found in the map and fill it as much as possible with the money spread around the map. The team that brings more money to their base wins the game.
name: Bankers & Bonkers

short_description: Play as a young, peaceful mage who will soon hold the destiny of the peoples of Albuvia in his hands. Go on an adventure and try to solve the riddle of the reappearance of evil.
name: Age Of Albuvia

short_description: Memories of war Undead Decimation is a fast paced third person shooter. Save the world single handedly or with a 4 player squad. Journey through different landscapes as you take on the undead. Can you defeat the undead?
name: Memories of War Undead Decimation

short_description: Skye is being reforged as Skye: Rebirth — a complete, ground-up rework of the Viking survival game, rebuilding core systems, combat, exploration, visuals, and survival mechanics. Existing owners will automatically retain access once the new version replaces the current one.
name: Skye: The Misty Isle

short_description: Gehinnom is a multiplayer horror game for 1-4 players. collect clues and complete various quests to perform a ritual and banish the demon that hunts you. Everything in Gehinnom is randomly generated, so you will always be scared.
name: Gehinnom

short_description: A unique, one of a kind hunting experience. Call and hunt predators, earn money and upgrade to better equipment. Are you the next Night Hunter?
name: Night Hunter

short_description: A first-person dungeon crawler where you explore a procedurally generated dark world with dungeons. You only have your lantern for light. Don't let it run out as you explore the world and dungeons.
name: Light Crawler

short_description: This is the life of Ralph, a teenage raccoon, in this story you will experience the most incredible moments of his life. In this relaxing experience, accompany Ralph, his friends, his girlfriend and his family, told in 5 handmade illustrated scenes. Have a calm and relaxing experience.
name: Thats Life of Ralph

short_description: "League of Felt Tanks: Together" is an online multiplayer game. Exhilarating PVP modes and engaging COOP gameplay that fosters camaraderie! Experience the best of classic tank warfare gaming in a cute felt world!
name: League of Felt Tanks: Together

short_description: A dark fantasy action RPG where a fallen witch reshapes the world. Explore dangerous dungeons, fight twisted enemies, and grow stronger through immersive combat and powerful gear. Power demands a price.
name: Star Witch

short_description: Build the strongest team of pets and tussle with your friends!
name: Super Auto Pets

short_description: Smash skeletons, defeat dragons, and battle giant golems in Tiny Tina's Assault on Dragon Keep: A Wonderlands One-Shot Adventure. Experience the acclaimed 2013 quest that started it all in this standalone campaign jam-packed with fantasy, fun, and mountains of magical loot!
name: Tiny Tina's Assault on Dragon Keep: A Wonderlands One-shot Adventure

short_description: A spooky trick-or-treat adventure about a mischievous puppy on a mission to score the evening's best candy. Create your costume, explore the neighborhood, and help your friends track down a menacing monster to save Halloween.
name: Howloween Hero

short_description: The Fall of Balance is a VR, fantasy game focused on Colossal boss fights, each with various mechanics, like climbing, character Skills, and others.
name: The Fall of Balance

short_description: Welcome to Pets Hotel, a place where you can start the business you always dreamed of! Pets Hotel gives you a unique opportunity to build, design, and run a place where pets can feel at home. Cats, dogs, turtles, and many other animals are waiting for you to take care of them!
name: Pets Hotel

short_description: An online game of challenges, fragile alliances and betrayal for up to 12 players. Escape elimination through diplomacy or deceit! The last remaining player wins.

short_description: Boo Men is a 1-4 player online co-op horror game. You and your crew of burglars are tasked with stealing from ghosts. Just remember to stay in the light because you never know what could be lurking in the dark...

short_description: A 3 minute tag-battle with extra twists! Play as a Monster who must lock everyone into jail before time runs out, or as a Human who must avoid capture and bail their teammates out of trouble. Invite your friends and family to play this speedy game of cat and mouse - or rather, Monsters and Humans!
name: Bail or Jail(OBAKEIDORO!)

short_description: Roll into a crazy 32-player Brawler Royale of pumped-up tires to be the last one standing. Overcome the laws of physics, perform aerial tricks and knock down tires to survive against the other players! Be a Rubber Brawl legend!

short_description: "Fallen Relics" is an ARPG-type adventure-themed game. You and your friends can use characters of different professions to explore, fight, collect, and decrypt in various themed levels; you can develop your character in a variety of ways and then challenge powerful bosses.
name: Fallen Relics

short_description: A combination Shooter and Action-Adventure game where the player is the hungry fox that needs to hunt food (Chickens, Rabbits, etc.). There are large predators (Bears, Wolves, etc.) that the fox must shoot using bullets that are earned as rewards.
name: Fox Goes Hunting ™

short_description: A new multiplayer, third-person, horror experience: Escape from an appaling environment by solving different puzzles with the help of your friends, and hiding from a hideous monster... or maybe becoming one ;) Unlock new maps, cosmetics and skins with the new Horror Night DLCs
name: Horror Night

short_description: A first-person thriller exploration game, based on a true story. Centered around the memory-driven nightmares of a young woman who has been imprisoned by her childhood trauma. Release all the memories locked in and beware of the creatures of the night.
name: CABOUS

short_description: This is an online cooperative coin pusher game set in the Old japan that can be enjoyed by one or all. Collect Japanese koban and try to win the jackpot! In addition, by collecting prizes, new content is released and coins are easily increased. Online multiplayer for up to five players possible.
name: Old Coin Pusher Friends

short_description: Harvest resources to build a village of woodland critters in this adaptation of the award-winning tabletop board game!

short_description: Find over 500 hidden objects across multiple levels, coloring them along the way. There is also an exciting mini-game in the game and puzzles on the treasure island.
name: FIND ALL 2: Middle Ages

short_description: Eyes of Hellfire is a co-op gothic horror game inspired by tabletop games, but with a twist - the insidious Host can manipulate your sense of reality
name: Eyes of Hellfire

short_description: Investigate haunted locations solo or with up to 4 players. Gather evidence, identify the entity, and survive deadly paranormal encounters before eliminating the ghost and escaping alive.

short_description: "Nightmare: Origins" is a multiplayer horror game for four players that immerses you in a nightmarish world between the realm of the dead and the realm of the living.Do you dare to face your fears and unravel the mysteries of Nightmare: Origins?

short_description: Project SNAQE is an action and precision game inspired by the classic Snake. Drill, shoot and expand your super mining machine as you try to deal with monsters along the way. Simple and easy to play but hard to master.
name: Project SNAQE

short_description: An action game where you play as a forest`s pagan god in the WW II times. Use god`s magic, brute force, sharp claws, and Nazi`s weapons to drive Germans away from your land.
name: Mythic: Forest Warden

short_description: An ultra-realistic multiplayer sword fighting game. Physics drive everything. Clash blades with competitors in neon-lit streets. Create your own style from endless possibilities. Become a legend. Parry, pivot, and thrust your way to victory.
name: Cyberpunk Samurai VR

short_description: Embark on a haunting journey into the cold in this narrative adventure - either alone or with a friend. IKUMA tells the story of Sam, a teenage boy who finds himself stranded in the Arctic with his dog. He must face not only its harsh environment, but also something lurking deeper in the shadows.
name: IKUMA - The Frozen Compass

short_description: Build and upgrade your personal ship to travel around a strange planet.
name: Astral Shipwright

short_description: A 1-4 player co-op survival horror where the horror begins when the shift starts. Clean, organize, and contain dangerous creatures using CCTV, motion sensors, and more. Earn your paycheck, upgrade your tools, and capture them. New game mode available!

short_description: "COROCONNECT" is a multiplayer-only action game where teamwork is key. Players use various gimmicks to tackle different stages. Synchronized cooperation is essential for success! Team up with friends or online players to clear all the stages!
name: COROCONNECT

short_description: Confused, you wake up sucked into an empty classroom. You have to try to escape from school by solving puzzles and discovering secrets.
name: Escape From School

short_description: Paint your victory in a battle royale and other colorful modes! POW POW: Dye it Up! is an immersive multiplayer family-friendly PvP game for VR.
name: POW POW: Dye it up!

short_description: You find yourself in a difficult situation, tired of all the city-life and decided that it’s for the best if you move into a camp in the woods with the friend you love the most – Ozzy. What adventures await you?
name: Last Minute

short_description: Dream up the ultimate Minifigure brawlers and bash your way through all of your favorite LEGO® themes in the first team action brawler set in the LEGO universe. Play with friends at home or around the world and see how you stack up against the competition.
name: LEGO® Brawls

short_description: Learn and explore the world of a professional photography. Join adventure of the wild life. Hunt and shoot best pictures. Sell your photos to magazines, buy and upgrade your gear, and whenever you get tired of waiting for a perfect shot there are ways to brighten your day waiting for you.
name: Photography Simulator

short_description: 2-4 player co-op horror experience. Conduct a train across an infinite field of tall grass. Scavenge for parts in old train factories to prevent a breakdown. But I'd be careful; whatever is lurking within is waiting for you to come to it.
name: Prairie

short_description: Monkey Mansion is a high-paced online co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Your mission is to obtain the priceless relics hidden inside a lavish 1920's Russian mansion. Recover them all without getting caught by the old pet proboscis monkey that was affected by the maniacal rituals performed there.
name: Monkey Mansion

short_description: Gun up and wreak havoc in Gambit! – a 4-player campaign-driven shooter-adventure in a world of gangs, guns, and mayhem.
name: Gambit!

short_description: Shadow Wave is a Metroidvania-style action rogue lite. Explore different biomes always with different arrangements. With the help of your faithful companion, move fast, be precise in combat and watch your powers grow stronger. Evolve in death and enjoy the path.
name: ShadoWave - Revenger

short_description: XIO Survival is a level-based-instance experience. Start by launching inside your own player-housing-level; where you have the ability to store loot, decorate, or even invite friends to enjoy your personal space. stay vigilant and collect resources to craft necessary weapons and armor to survive.

name: The Chewllers

short_description: DO NOT PLAY! This 8bit game is a port from a mystery source...This casual, linier, interactive story game centers around a campfire with old friends telling... tales.
name: Campfire Tales

short_description: A bitter RPG where every enemy has their own unique minigame, and where there are two sides to every soul: Main and Invert!
name: Furquest

short_description: Compete online against your friends and other players in this chaotic and fast paced 4-player game of tag! Race across different locations, jump through windows, electrocute the other players, or throw cats at them. (No cats were harmed in the production of this game.)
name: Catch Me!

short_description: Solomon Division is a co-op horror game where you play as an employee of agency that hunts demons invading your country. Play together with your friends as Technician or Medium and seal the demons. Walk the path from a beginner agent to the veteran whose name makes the Devil himself shiver in fear.
name: Solomon Division

short_description: I Love Finding Pups is a classic Hidden Object game. Explore stunning locations through hidden object scenes and minigames while collecting all the adorable pups!
name: I Love Finding Pups

short_description: Can you create the biggest dog pack?
name: DOGS.IO

short_description: Escape the open-world island infested with monster spiders while on duty as a prisoner alone or with your friends. Loot the city, destroy the caves, take some selfies on the way out in your car before you set sail.
name: Odd Remedy

short_description: Nosos is a cooperative horror game from 1 to 4 players. Find all the demonic objects and complete a ritual without getting caught by the monster in the house.
name: Nosos

short_description: "Where is Paradise?" is an party multiplayer game for 3 to 8 players. Dive into purgatory in search of Paradise, but beware of corrupted souls trying to stop you. Form alliances, thwart their plans, and discover who can truly be trusted. Ready for the challenge?
name: Where is Paradise ?

short_description: The Freelance Police are back on the crime beat in a newly remastered version of their second episodic season. Zombies will dance. Mariachis will sing. A giant battle robot will trash the streets. And when their friends’ lives are at stake, Sam & Max will risk their very souls to set things right.
name: Sam & Max: Beyond Time and Space

short_description: Lighthaze World – A cozy puzzle adventure! Explore a charming world, solve nonlinear puzzles, and find treasure. Help an anxious hero overcome fears to rescue their loyal dog. Perfect for fans of relaxing story-driven games.
name: Lighthaze World

short_description: A SurvivalHorrror/Metroidvania game were the world has a constant rain, full of beauty, magic, horror and sadness. Discover an unique story that will touch each of your emotions.
name: RAIN IN THE ABYSS

short_description: A zombie shooter where you can build your base and craft items to help you survive.
name: Finding Home

short_description: The name says it all - in The Hunt, you get, well, hunted by hunters who will do everything they can to hunt you down. In order to survive, you must explore, scavenge, craft, and fight in order to survive. And if you survive and scavenge for long enough, there might just be a way to escape.
name: The Hunt

short_description: An unexpected collaboration from Tsugunohi, the game where horror invades daily life, and VTuber Inugami Korone, from VTuber group hololive. Inugami Korone, who has been live streaming many horror game, has become an evil goddess and taken over Tsugunohi. Now, chop your finger and give it to her.
name: Evil God Korone

short_description: Somni is a thrilling paranormal investigation first person shooter. Investigate your surroundings and survive your encounters with Ethereal Beings or Cryptids.
name: SOMNI

short_description: M.I.S.V is an SCP INSPIRED and FEAR Organisation that works as a Cleaner and Capture Unit for different threads. Play alone or with Friends against terrifying Enemies controlled by a Player or AI, or fight against other players in competitive and coop Modes.
name: M.I.S.V VR

short_description: A stray dog survives in a cruel world of humans and animals. There are two ways: to become a wolf or to give humanity a chance. Paper Bum is a dark adventure that looks like the drawings of a sad child.
name: Paper Bum

short_description: Immerse yourself in a realistic struggle to survive in an African wildlife reserve. Explore the daily lives of hundreds of wild animals, & the complicated roles that humans play in the environment. Travel a vast open world & discover the history of the giant caldera known as The Great Circle.
name: THE GREAT CIRCLE

short_description: The world is under a frantic alien attack. Amidst the chaos and with the army virtually subdued, the deadliest and most inconsequential pair of specialists are called upon to do what must be done. Join the war hunting aliens around the world and in every way possible.
name: Wild Dogs

short_description: Bridge of Dawn is a free, open-sourced 3D arcade/racing style game for one or two players. Follow the story of Vulpes the Fox as he rushes to catch the sun and find out the secret to everlasting life in this lighthearted and fun game for all ages.
name: Bridge of Dawn

short_description: Destroy robots and send humans flying by ramming into them as a big angry elephant, or a giant mammoth and cause as much chaos as possible. The objective is simple but it won't be easy. Features fast paced action.
name: ELE RAMPAGE

short_description: "Once Upon a Time in the Colony" is a third-person game with simulation survival, action and shooting elements. Go to virtual amusement parks called "colony" in parallel time and space. Survive and develop, farm, explore and fight in various harsh environments. Write your own legendary story.
name: Once Upon a Time in the Colony

short_description: Everything is for Humanity is a story-driven, exploration and puzzle-solving based science fiction horror game which sets in a massive science facility in 2020. You will discover tons of things and find out about the blood-chilling truths with its first-person experience.
name: Everything Is For Humanity

short_description: Dive into a hilarious sandbox BBQ experience with friends! Grill, serve, and manage mayhem as meats soar and sizzle. Craft your grill, cook steaks, and feed everyone before hunger strikes!
name: BBQ Simulator: The Squad

short_description: Based on the SCP Foundation "Keter" is a Dead by Daylight and Left4Dead-inspired Multiplayer Game.
name: SCP: Keter

short_description: Unsafe Express is a cooperative first-person survival horror game for 1-4 players. Navigate through space stations, collect materials and outlast your enemies! Choose your objective based on complexity levels, then cast your vote. Gather items, exterminate hostiles, fulfill missions and repeat!
name: Unsafe Express

short_description: A simple hard worker living in the village is doing his job, when suddenly there are power outages in the village, by a lucky chance our hero has an electrician pig and the right tool, taking a tractor, they went to look for a malfunction at the substation, what could go wrong?
name: Light, Dark or Hrak?

short_description: 元宇宙开放世界自定义游戏社区！
name: Metaverse-World Of Cube

short_description: Follow Bucky, a brave and faithful dog, and his friend Shin on a journey through a mysterious dungeon in this relaxing and minimalist slide puzzle game.
name: Slide Stories: Bucky's Quest

short_description: Multiplayer/Singleplayer shooter in low-poly style. NPCs sell weapons, perks, and health packs. Different zombies, handmade maps, unlockable barriers, 34 weapons. Zombies spawn endlessly. And more!
name: ToBas Zombies

short_description: Little Island offers you the experience of interacting with a variety of cute animals in a VR space. Dive into a world full of nature and adorable animal children. You will be healed by interacting with the lively animals. Help them in their time of need, play with them, and love them.
name: Little Island

short_description: Round-based 1-4 player co-op zombie FPS, where you survive endless rounds of zombies that get tougher every round. Unlock and upgrade gear between missions in the PlayerHub!
name: Realm of the Undead

short_description: You're stranded on an island with other players. Your goal is to explore the island, collect as many resources as possible, and then try to escape the island to replenish your camp's stock.
